name: business_set
description: Store the issuer profile printed at the top of every invoice: your name, address, VAT id, bank details and defaults (currency, tax rate, payment terms, invoice number prefix). Call this once before creating invoices.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Your business or freelancer name

arguments.name: address
arguments.desc: Postal address, newlines allowed

arguments.name: vat_id
arguments.desc: VAT / tax registration id

arguments.name: iban
arguments.desc: IBAN or account number for payment

arguments.name: bank
arguments.desc: Bank name / BIC

arguments.name: logo_path
arguments.desc: Path to a PNG or JPG logo (Pro)

arguments.name: default_currency
arguments.desc: ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD, JPY. Default EUR

arguments.name: default_tax_rate
arguments.desc: Default VAT percent applied to items without their own rate

arguments.name: payment_terms_days
arguments.desc: Default days until due. Default 14

arguments.name: invoice_prefix
arguments.desc: Invoice number prefix, default INV (custom prefix is Pro)

name: client_add
description: Store a client so invoices can refer to them by name. Re-adding the same name updates the stored details.

arguments.name: vat_id
arguments.desc: Client VAT id, printed for reverse-charge invoices

name: client_list
description: List every stored client with their id, address, email and VAT id.

name: invoice_create
description: Create an invoice for a client from a list of items. Allocates the next invoice number (never reused), computes subtotal, discount, tax lines per rate and the total. Amounts are held as integer minor units; every line is rounded first, then summed.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client name or id. Unknown names are added automatically

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: Line items

arguments.name: issue_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today

arguments.name: due_days
arguments.desc: Days until due, defaults to your payment terms

arguments.name: notes
arguments.desc: Free text printed under the totals

arguments.name: discount_percent
arguments.desc: Discount percent applied to every line before tax, 0-100

name: invoice_from_hours
description: Shortcut for the common case: bill one client for N hours at an hourly rate. Creates a single-line invoice.

arguments.name: rate
arguments.desc: Hourly rate in major units

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: Line description, default 'Consulting services'

name: invoice_list
description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status (unpaid, paid, partial), client, and an issue-date range.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive

name: invoice_get
description: Return the full stored record for one invoice number, including every line and tax breakdown.

name: invoice_mark_paid
description: Record a payment. Without an amount the invoice is marked fully paid; a smaller amount marks it partial and reports the remaining balance.

arguments.name: paid_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today

arguments.name: amount
arguments.desc: Amount received in major units. Omit for the full total

name: invoice_pdf
description: Render an invoice as an A4 PDF you can send: issuer block, client block, dates, item table with wrapped descriptions, subtotal, discount, tax lines per rate, total, payment details and notes. Returns the file path.

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the PDF. Defaults to the data directory

name: overdue_report
description: List every unpaid or partly paid invoice past its due date with days overdue, plus outstanding totals per currency. Pro.

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
